title: BLACKRIDGE
short_description: Night-rain modern-military FPS in Meridian Ward, Zarov: a full campaign mission plus seven PVP modes across three arenas, with classes, a gunsmith, tactical gear, daily challenges and a 55-level career.
description:
One game, eight ways to fight, all under the same night storm.

CAMPAIGN — RAVEN 2-1, you are going in alone. Meridian Ward is a blacked-out harbor district held by Vektor Ancile private military contractors. Work the infiltration from the docks, take the plaza, and reach the CINDERLOCK uplink before exfil closes. One mission, six beats, checkpoint respawns.

PVP — ten operators a match on three arenas:
- LANTERNWALK — the harbour carve, shipping containers and lantern-lit arcades through the ward's densest blocks.
- SWITCHYARD — a tram depot: a covered running shed between two stabling yards, standing cars and gantries for cover.
- SALTMARKET — a covered market: one great hall under a gallery walkway, wrapped in narrow rows of shuttered stalls.

Seven modes:
- SKIRMISH — 5v5 team deathmatch, AMBER vs SLATE. First to 50 kills in 8:00.
- CAPTURE THE FLAG — 5v5, mirrored flag rooms, 3 captures to win.
- FREE-FOR-ALL — everyone for themselves, first to 25 kills; the leader is marked.
- STRONGHOLD — 5v5, three zones: every zone you hold scores; first to 200.
- OUTPOST — 5v5, one outpost live at a time and it keeps moving; hold it alone to score, first to 250.
- RECLAIM — 5v5, every fallen operator drops a tag: grab an enemy's to confirm the kill, a teammate's to deny it. First to 40.
- ASCENT — free-for-all gun ladder: every kill hands you the next weapon, and the last rung is the knife.
Ties go to overtime.

LOADOUTS — five editable classes, picked in warm-up or while you wait to redeploy: a primary and a secondary from seven original weapons (M-72 Warden rifle, KS-23 Vesper SMG, B-12 Breaker pump shotgun, LR-1 Corvus marksman rifle, HX-60 Bastion belt-fed machine gun, GS-9 Pike pistol, KR-5 Anvil rocket launcher), a lethal (frag or tripmine), a tactical (flashbang, smoke or concussion) and three perks. The gunsmith fits optics, muzzles, grips, lasers, extended mags and rapid fire, with camos earned by levelling each weapon. Prefer a pistol start with guns on the map? Pick it in the menu.

Earn a Signal Sweep (3 kills), a mortar strike (5), an airstrike (7) or an orbital barrage (10). Modern-military movement: sprint, slide, mantle, aim down sights, cook grenades, and a quick knife. Operators wear six different kits, and you can look down and see your own legs and shadow. Your teammates call contacts, flanks and objectives in a team chat strip, with subtitles as an accessibility option. Every match feeds a 55-level career, daily and weekly challenges and an after-action report; a replay kill cam shows how you went down. Six settings tabs include colour-blind team palettes and full controller support with aim assist.

Plays on phones and tablets too: landscape, with a move stick, drag-to-look, on-screen buttons and tap-to-call killstreaks.
controls_keyboard: WASD move · Mouse look · LMB fire · RMB aim · R reload · SHIFT sprint · CTRL crouch (slide while sprinting) · SPACE jump/mantle · 1-5 weapons (wheel cycles, Q last) · V knife · G lethal (frag/tripmine) · E tactical · F interact · I inspect · 6/7/8/9 killstreaks (7-9 aim then click) · L class · M map · TAB scoreboard · ESC pause
